item.title: Easter Bunny
item.content:encoded:
Looking for greenlight: Yes

Page type: Main Article

Genre: Horror

Layout: Normal

Elevator Pitch: Essentially the Easter Bunny, but with an SCP universe twist on it

Central Naritive: A relativly hairless (besides wiskers) humanoid creature with the features of a rabbit that visits people/families who do not celebrate the holiday of Easter, and will hide eggs around either their home each egg is made from actual egg shell and are larger compared to normal eggs, each a diffrent color representing what is inside

White eggs:

+ show block
– hide block

Once opened a mutated baby chick will be inside, normally one part of it enlarged


Yellow eggs:
+ show block
– hide block

Contain a small carved figurine out of bone or wood depicting a biblical figure


Blue eggs:
+ show block
– hide block

contain something related to the person, ie: something they lost, a child hood toy, or something related to a hobby

In most instances white, yellow and blue eggs are the only eggs found, with the majority being white and yellow, however the green, red, and black eggs have special requirements to be given

Green eggs:

+ show block
– hide block

can obtained be seeing the creature the creature, inside are small unknown harmless creatures, entity can speak through cameras and anything left behind in footage will appear when are is not in veiw


Red eggs:
+ show block
– hide block

Obtained when purposefully harming another egg, comtain small creatures again, however this time they are destructive


Black eggs:
+ show block
– hide block

Obtained by stating you do not except "him" to the creature, contains "something" very violent that after being open reseals itself and is unknown to the foundation


Grey egss:
+ show block
– hide block

If at anytime someone refers to the creature as the "Easter Bunny" the creature will become enraged and will appear in reflective surfaces near the person and the person will dissappear with a Grey egg in their place, which cannot be cracked open no matter how much force is applied, muffled screams can be heard within

The SCP interview logs will incorporate Christian lore/mythology
